description: Plans, coordinates and customizes PAC CLI-downloaded Standard or Enhanced data model non-SPA Power Pages sites created from Microsoft templates or manually in Design Studio. Use for requests involving pages, localized content, navigation, assets, snippets, site markers, Liquid/web templates, page layouts, or styling. Coordinated work produces an approved browser-viewable plan, executes changes in dependency order, verifies the local result, and optionally hands off to deployment. Not for React, Angular, Vue, or Astro SPA sites.
